Bases de Manresa 61-73, Manresa — sole teaching centre stated ('Location: Manresa School of Engineering' / 'Lloc d'impartició: Escola Politècnica Superior d'Enginyeria de Manresa'). NOT Barcelona: Manresa is ~65 km inland from Barcelona
university_awarding: Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya (UPC) — public university, awards the degree in its own name
boe_order: Verification 25/09/2013; Consejo de Ministros 14/11/2014; BOE publication 29/12/2014; institutional accreditation 10/09/2024 (RUCT detail page)
europe_recognition: EHEA level 7 (Bologna) — academic recognition across the EHEA. Official Spanish máster universitario, MECES 3 = EQF 7, second cycle, Diploma Supplement issued, doctoral access. CAVEAT: EHEA academic recognition is not professional recognition (regulated professions run through Directive 2005/36/EC and a separate national process), and recognition abroad still needs the receiving country's own procedure — the EHEA makes it routine, not automatic
tuition_eu_eur: EUR 1,592 (2026-27 rates) — UPC's own approximate total for EU/resident students
fees_extra_eur: EUR 218.15 compulsory study of equivalence of a non-EU foreign degree for master's access (Decret 96/2026 annex 1 art. 7.4.1); EUR 30.21 study of documentation/academic record for master's selection (art. 7.6); academic-record management EUR 54.54 per semester / EUR 69.80 annual (art. 7.1); learning-support resources EUR 35.00 per semester / EUR 70.00 annual (UPC table); EUR 218.15 issue of the official degree certificate with European Diploma Supplement (annex 1 art. 4.1); EUR 300 non-refundable advance payment on accepting admission (UPC fees page). None of these are included in the tuition figures above
modality: presencial and semipresencial (face-to-face and blended learning), afternoons
language_of_instruction: NOT STATED as a single language — UPC prints verbatim 'Consulta l'idioma d'impartició de cada assignatura a la guia docent dintre del pla d'estudis' / 'Check the language of instruction for each subject in the course guide'. NOT FOUND at programme level
start_month: February and September — UPC page states 'Starting September and February'. CONFIRMED February intake
notes: FEE ARITHMETIC. 90 ECTS. This is a máster habilitant under Decret 96/2026 annex 2, so the EU/resident credit price is 17.69 EUR: 17.69 x 90 = 1592.1, and UPC prints 1,592 EUR. Non-EU: 45.00 x 90 = 4,050 EUR. Non-EU non-resident: Decret 96/2026 art. 1.5 lets each social council set the price up to 100% of cost and states that a long-stay study authorisation 'no equival a la condició de residents', so this Tunisian candidate is legally non-resident; UPC's own 2026-27 table sets a single differentiated TOTAL price of 45 EUR/credit for 'Màster universitari habilitant i no habilitant (no residents, no UE)' — it is not an add-on. Recognised/validated credits are charged at 20% of the normal price (Decret 96/2026 art. 6.1), i.e. 9.00 EUR/credit for a non-EU student, so any advanced standing for the candidate's 300-ECTS Tunisian degree cuts cost. CONFLICT (UPC's own FAQ): the UPC master's FAQ still prints 102.52 EUR/credit for non-EU non-resident students, contradicting UPC's own 2026-27 price table (45 EUR) and every programme page's non-EU total. The 45 EUR figure is the one consistent with the published totals and is used here; the FAQ figure is stale and is logged, not used. Habilitant rate applies because Decret 96/2026 annex 2 lists 'Enginyeria de Mines'. RUCT code CONFIRMED: the UPC page's own 'Official degree' link points at CodigoEstudio=4314013, matching the register (90 ECTS, 'TITULACION RENOVADA POR ACREDITACION INSTITUCIONAL'); the batch input carried no code. 300-ECTS candidate: RUCT does not publish a complementos formativos row — NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT, not zero. New intake places: 15 face-to-face + 15 blended. Profession-qualifying master (ingeniero de minas), so professional recognition abroad runs through Directive 2005/36/EC separately from EHEA academic recognition.
